{{Quote|Here come the tinnies. Okay, my lads, time to make shrapnel.|Aven|<ref name="O66" />}}
'''Aven''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], and a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Aven was one of one hundred [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|Alpha-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]] that made up part of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Aven would serve the Republic as a [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the Grand Army's [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]]. During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Aven led [[Clone commando/Legends|Republic commando]] [[Squad/Legends|squads]] [[Omega Squad|Omega]] and [[Yayax Squad|Yayax]] in defense of the [[HNE Headquarters|headquarters]] of [[HoloNet News and Entertainment]] so that the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] station would be able to continue transmitting to the citizens of Coruscant and the Republic.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Are we keeping you awake, Shiny Boy? Look sharp. The tinnies are going to be back again. Got to keep the voice of freedom and democracy on the air.|Aven|<ref name="O66" />}}
Aven was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], and a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Grown in secret on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Aven was one of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] one hundred elite [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|Alpha-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]].<ref name="O66" /> Like all of the Alpha-class ARC troopers, Aven was trained on Kamino by Jango Fett himself. However, the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] felt that the ARC trooper's fierce independence made them unpredictable and had them put into [[Stasis tube|stasis]] until the [[First Battle of Kamino|Battle of Kamino]] in the [[21 BBY/Legends|first year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]; with the planet under attack by the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] had the ARC troopers taken out of stasis to assist in the battle. Once the battle was over and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] victorious,<ref name="TDoK">[[Republic 50|''Republic'' 50]]</ref> Aven and the other ARC troopers would enter Republic service as part of the Grand Army's [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]].<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>

By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the third and final year of the Clone Wars, Aven held the rank of [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the Grand Army. When the leader of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attacked]] the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Aven was on the surface to aid in the planet's defense. He led the [[Clone commando/Legends|Republic commandos]] of both [[Omega Squad|Omega]] and [[Yayax Squad|Yayax]] [[Squad/Legends|squads]] in protecting the [[HNE Headquarters|headquarters]] of [[HoloNet News and Entertainment]], ensuring that the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] station would continue to broadcast to the citizens of Coruscant. Once the employees of HNE had assembled a mobile transmitter, both the transmitter and close to a dozen HNE staff members were loaded into a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] and moved to a more secure location. Aven and the commandos then moved into the foyer of HNE headquarters, where they would hold the building throughout the nearly week-long battle.<ref name="O66" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Sir, do you know if comms to Kashyyyk are operational yet?''"<br />"''I've heard it's patchy. Why—waiting for a call from a Wookiee?''"<br />"''Something like that.|[[Darman Skirata|RC-1136]] and Aven|<ref name="O66" />}}
Aven possessed a cynic's sharp humor, often quiet but cutting at times. He was critical of [[Republic Defense Procurement Office/Legends|Republic Defense Procurement]] and what Aven viewed as their underwhelming track record, but also sympathetic to the needs of his fellow clone [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. In battle, Aven was not afraid of confronting a Separatist [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droid]] at close quarters, and his position as an ARC [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] afforded him the ability to call in air support from nearby gunships.<ref name="O66" />

==Equipment==
As an Alpha-class ARC trooper, Aven wore the hardier [[ARC trooper armor/Legends|ARC trooper armor]] rather than the more common [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II]] [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]] worn by standard [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. During the Battle of Coruscant, Aven also made use of twin [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17]] [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] to combat the Separatist battle droids.<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ARC trooper nicknamed Aven first appeared in the fourth installment of the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] entitled ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', by author [[Karen Traviss]].
